statements.text: We have learned in previous phases the subject of ratio, and that ratio is a comparison between two quantities.
The ratio between two numbers a and b can be written as a to b, or a:b, or a/b. Formula: $a \text{ to } b, \ a:b, \ \frac{a}{b}$
In the ratio a:b, a is called the antecedent and b the consequent; a and b together are the two terms of the ratio.
